decisive_items: Multiple cysts in the posterior fossa
response.rationale: The posterior fossa cysts with obstructive hydrocephalus explain the intracranial hypertension symptoms; this is not idiopathic, ruling out R3/R4, and MS is unsupported.

rejected.why: Obstructive hydrocephalus contradicts pseudotumor cerebri (idiopathic etiology).
Obstructive hydrocephalus contradicts idiopathic intracranial hypertension.
No demyelinating features; cysts and hydrocephalus are not MS findings.
